title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ojt7: fuzz_fragment.rs still uses old Fragment::from_bytes 2-arg API
description:
The commit efb5d298 changed Fragment::from_bytes to take only 1 argument (removing the tile buffer parameter). The integration test tests/fragmentation.rs was correctly updated, but fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs line 8 still calls Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile) with 2 arguments. This causes a compilation failure when building the fuzz target.

Fix: remove the &mut tile argument and the now-dead tile variable on line 7.

Additionally, there are pre-existing compilation errors in src/fragment.rs under the std feature (rule_id Option<u8> mismatches, fragments_in_window rename, Ack::new bitmap type mismatch) that are NOT caused by this commit but prevent any std-dependent test from compiling.
